d: Long, flowing platinum white hair flows wildly behind a muscular, mature build with a pale chest marked by several reddish-brown scars. A dark grey metallic mask covers the face, revealing only glowing red eyes through narrow slits. The outfit consists of dark charcoal grey armored trousers and matching armored boots, leaving the muscular upper body exposed. A massive, curved red blade with circular indentations is held aloft.
